title: ECCR 真实 Provider 案例与表层回答诊断聚合

method.name: Evidence-Contract + Counterfactual-Closure Reconstruction
online_route: L0 deterministic identity and temporal truth
L3 bounded ECCR for ambiguity, feedback, or explicit deep analysis

evidence_boundary.masked_temporal_case: One repeatedly used development call. Source cutoff is audited, but the case is contaminated and lacks independent human blind review.
evidence_boundary.fixed_packet_cases: Oracle synthesis diagnostics over frozen evidence packets. Candidate generation and end-to-end retrieval are not evaluated.
evidence_boundary.surface_case: One fixed generation matrix. Gold was physically absent during generation and loaded only for post-generation scoring.
evidence_boundary.semantic_scores: Source overlap and model-judge scores are not human semantic accuracy. Post-hoc evidence review is reported separately.
evidence_boundary.privacy: No raw message, query, account, group, source-key value, endpoint, credential, or provider configuration is included.

attempts.semantic_finding: The internal brief recovered the temporal contrast and preserved that purchase intent is not direct evidence of payment, pre-order, or launch rushing.

generation.posthoc_finding: Natural but generic; the historical chain was not recovered.
Recovered the prior dislike and launch-period play while explicitly qualifying launch-rush uncertainty; omitted purchase intent and one genre attribution.
Used richer context but surface compression dropped two core anchors and did not explicitly qualify the absence of direct launch-rush or pre-order evidence.

surface_answer_case.interpretation: The raw model judge preferred ECCR, while post-hoc atomic evidence review preferred B16. This is direct evidence that final reading and compression must be evaluated separately from retrieval and brief quality.

runs.semantic_finding: Found both temporal segments and explicitly kept intentional linkage uncertain.
Missed the key derogatory reaction despite an automatic recall of 1.0.
Fail-closed after the second response omitted previously selected uncertainty evidence.
Recovered both temporal segments and source-role caveats but kept them inside a broad irony candidate instead of constructing the protected euphemism-and-second-order-rejoke hypothesis.

pragmatic_language_case.metric_warning: All successful synthesis arms received automatic required-group recall 1.0; the metric therefore failed to distinguish the known semantic miss.

llm_diagnostics.finding: The visible content described the same-account aliases correctly but omitted the structured subject object.
Explicitly emitted the correct subject binding but added no deterministic identity truth beyond the host.

identity_case.interpretation: Stable account binding belongs at L0. The LLM may interpret referring expressions but must not merge accounts or cross scopes.

supported: ECCR can produce an auditable calibrated brief on one masked temporal case.
Full ECCR is too slow for synchronous execution on every chat request under the measured provider.
Deterministic identity outperforms LLM use on stable account facts.
Evidence coverage, hypothesis construction, and final surface reading are separate failure surfaces.
not_supported: ECCR is generally more accurate than the weak baseline, one-pass synthesis, or full-MR.
Automatic source-group recall is semantic accuracy.
The pragmatic-language core hypothesis test has passed.
A model-judge score from one contaminated case is a win rate.
decision.next_protocol_change: Permit a second-round AUDIT_DISCOVERY interpretation only when it cites previously unselected evidence, discriminates an existing interpretation, remains HYPOTHESIS or CONTESTED, and is surfaced as unresolved; it may not be promoted directly into persistent graph truth.
